raw_comment: In this graph, droughts around the country are being shown. The country is color coded to depict how bad the drought is and/or how dry it is. The I noticed how most of the country is at least yellow. Yellow is abnormally dry. It is concerning that this is the state of the majority of the country. I wonder how long it will be before the country is mainly severe. I wonder how can we make it so we get our country out of this drought. This impacts my community because where I live we are in a drought to the point we are not allowed to have fire pits and can smell the wildfires resulting from the droughts. A catchphrase to name this graph could be "The USA Is Drying Up: How will we get out of this significant drought."
